observations: Priya matches checkin-patients.png: high ponytail with a blue scrunchie, small hoop earring, coral-pink block-print kurti, dark slate crossbody bag with its strap over her left shoulder and the bag at her right hip, large almond eyes with winged lashes. A small mark near her mouth agrees with the beauty spot. At this resolution I cannot tell for sure which side of the lip it is on. She smiles and walks briskly.

Hands: her left hand (screen-right) holds the phone. Her right index finger touches the green check-mark card on the screen, and the other fingers are curled. Finger count and contact look plausible. The screen faces the reader and shows only a calendar icon, a teal check card and small tap-spark strokes. There is no text.

The setting reads as a sunny street with the clinic's teal awning and glass entrance. Inside you can see the reception desk, a wall TV with an empty white strip, waiting chairs and a plant, which ties the shot to the clinic in 03-1 and 03-3. Plain sky at the upper left leaves room for the caption.
